description: Tell Clipwright what is missing or wrong. Call it when no tool does what the user asked (kind missing_capability), or when an answer was confusing (confusing), wrong (wrong_result) or far too slow (slow), instead of rephrasing the request and giving up. Say what the user wanted, what you tried and what came back; pass run_id when it is about a run. We read every one. Free, spends nothing. Sending the same kind, text and run again within 24 hours answers the same feedback_id. 20 per hour per account.

kind.description: missing_capability: no tool does what the user asked; confusing: an answer or description was unclear; wrong_result: a result is not what was asked;

run_id.description: The run it is about, if any.

text.description: What the user wanted, what you tried and what came back, in plain words.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback
